hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); [[ "$f" == *.py && "$f" != */tests/* && "$f" != */test_* ]] && jq -n --arg path "$f" '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":("[CLAUDE.md doc-update] Modified " + $path + " — check the trigger table in CLAUDE.md and update README.md / ARCHITECTURE.md / SETUP.md before completing this task.")}}' || true
